glossEn: be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
note: be present at (meetings, church services, university)。线索：宾语是会议/课程/礼拜。She attended the conference in Beijing.

glossEn: take charge of or deal with
note: take charge of or deal with。线索：attend to + 事务/需求。He attended to the needs of his patients.

glossEn: to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result
note: to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result。线索：伴随主语（不接宾语）。Success attended on years of hard work.
give heed (to)。线索：attend to + 抽象名词。Attend to what your teacher is saying.
